# 7433 - Quadruple 2-input NOR buffer with open-collector

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7433.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7433.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 10 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7433 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7433.png) | ![7433 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nor-buf-oc2.png) | ![7433 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nor-buf-oc2.png) |

The 7428 symbol (X box running into all four corners, then a pointed end) with a vertical line down the centre of the box.

How to tell it on a drawing: Centre line in the box = open collector, the same mark as on 7401/7403.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1Y = NOT(1A OR 1B) | 1Y is the NOR of 1A, 1B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 4 | 2Y = NOT(2A OR 2B) | 2Y is the NOR of 2A, 2B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 10 | 3Y = NOT(3A OR 3B) | 3Y is the NOR of 3A, 3B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |
| 13 | 4Y = NOT(4A OR 4B) | 4Y is the NOR of 4A, 4B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 48 |
| outputMaxVoltageV | 5.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Open-collector buffer: IOL 48 mA vs 16 mA for 7402: can drive three times as many inputs or a long line. Open collector: no IOH figure applies; the datasheet gives an off-state leakage of max 0.25 mA at VOH 5.5 V instead. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 10 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 (the scan prints kohm), CL 50 pF |
| any | Y | PHL | 12 | 18 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 (the scan prints kohm), CL 50 pF |
| any | Y | PLH | 15 | 22 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 (the scan prints kohm), CL 150 pF |
| any | Y | PHL | 16 | 24 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 (the scan prints kohm), CL 150 pF |

## Not known

- Load resistor unit in the switching table: the scan reads '133 kohm'; the sister parts 7428/7437/7438 print 133 ohm. Not settled from the 7433 sheet itself.

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.

## Sources

- [TI SN5433/SN54LS33/SN7433/SN74LS33 datasheet SDLS101](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls33.pdf) - 1, 3; SN7433
